commands.text: A scrape travels along the outer passage. Aveline sets the carrier’s board safely inside.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: Keep this doorway clear. Nobody waiting here comes into the fight.

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: One behind the armor is sustaining the line. Look before choosing the target.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: We have room to hold. We have a reason to keep it.
The book remains on dry wood. The two women face the approach, not the waiting bench.
